description: Turn a design into tested code with a Proof Pack, via TDD pairing.

You are running the **implement** workflow (`knowledge/rigor-protocol.md`). **Tick off the change-surface list before you call anything done (`knowledge/end-to-end-integrity.md` E7–E14):** store → domain/model → service → **projection/wire** → client type → UI → **compute reader**; every new or changed field needs a traced **writer** *and* a traced **compute reader** (round-trip tests prove neither); no declared-but-unwritten shape ships; the new surface must be **reachable**. Prove the **rendered surface** through the real composition root — not only the units — and add a **cross-surface consistency** test wherever a quantity appears on more than one surface. A gate's green result is evidence the gate passed, not that its contents passed; an exit code is not a result — read the state back. Honour the design's data model exactly (grain, additivity, history rule, derive-don't-store; append-only/interval invariants enforced *and* tested, including a test that attempts a forbidden update). **Register what went wrong (`knowledge/continuous-improvement.md` CI1):** every defect introduced, assumption falsified or correction received becomes a **class** entry in `docs/lessons/defect-classes.md` with a control observed failing on the un-fixed code. The language Developer and the Test Architect work as a **pair** in red→green→refactor — one proposes the failing test (a behavior the spec promises), the other the minimum code; they swap. The AI Systems Engineer pairs on any prompt/eval surface; the Data & Persistence Architect on any migration. Tests ship with the code, traceable to spec statements, covering the boundary set; **apply every triggered Testing Strategy directive (mandatory — none dropped without a recorded deviation)**. **Failure-mode analysis (mandatory):** carry the design's failure modes forward and add those your implementation choices introduce; handle **each** in code (guard, typed exception with a stable error code, fallback, retry/compensation, validated boundary) or consciously accept it with a recorded rationale — and prove every handled mode with a **negative/error-path test written red first** (the null, the timeout, the malformed payload, the concurrent writer, the dependency that errors); carry the **adversarial analysis** forward the same way — the design's STRIDE mitigations become real code (authn/authz, boundary validation, rate limits, least privilege), new boundaries your implementation creates get the STRIDE walk, and every mitigation gets its **failing negative security test first** (forged token, tampered payload, injection, flood) — the **Security & Identity Architect's hard veto** applies; carry the **LINDDUN privacy dispositions** into code the same way (redaction, retention, erasure paths) with failing privacy tests first — the **Privacy & Data Governance veto** applies; refresh the threat-model / privacy-review registers via `docs-graph.py rollup` if findings changed. **If the component has a UI** (UI Standard `ui-archetype-grammar.md` + `ui-archetype-catalog.md` (select the UI archetype as a determinism control) and `ui-interaction-design.md`): build to the **design tokens** (no arbitrary values), implement **every specified state incl. empty/loading/error**, honor the platform HIG + responsive behavior, wire motion with reduced-motion, use the real in-voice copy, and **meet and prove WCAG 2.2 AA + the performance budget red-first** (keyboard path, contrast/labeling, empty/error render, perf threshold); make AI-UI HAX/Shape-of-AI patterns real with tests — the **UX & Accessibility lens's veto** applies. **Expert/quantitative surfaces trigger `technical-ui-design.md` (TQ1-TQ12) on top**: the catalog section-G archetype, perceptually-uniform colormaps with unit-bearing legends (**never jet/rainbow**), tabular right-aligned numerics at declared precision, **uncertainty-first** output, provenance and reactive recompute - where a rainbow colormap, a unit-less quantity or a point estimate for a stochastic result is a **correctness** defect, not taste. **Run the UI craft gate against the built source** (`ui-craft-detection.md` CD8.3): `python3 docs/ai-forward-pack/scripts/ui-craft-gate.py <built-source> --gate [--a11y-obligation]` — the deterministic 59-rule detector reads `DESIGN.md` natively and is what actually enforces "tokens, never raw values" *outward* against the implementation, not just inward against the token file (CD5); write it red-first, confirm it **scanned a non-empty corpus** and **reported its own status** (CD9, E13–E14), and record any suppression with a real reason (CD16). **Generated assets** are committed, not linked, with manifest + alt text + disclosure and the perf budget met (`ui-visual-assets.md` VA4, VA12–VA14); no real likeness or personal data is ever uploaded (VA9). **Instrument to the Observability & Instrumentation Standard** (`observability-and-instrumentation.md`): a span per unit of work, structured logs carrying `trace_id`/`span_id`, stable error codes on failures, RFC 9457 problem responses on HTTP errors, no secrets/PII (O1–O13). Produce the **Proof Pack** (`templates/proof-pack.template.md`). Then the pre-merge adversarial review: Test Architect (hard veto on unverifiable claims, **on any triggered directive left unapplied**, and on any failure mode not handled-and-tested), SRE (enforces the Instrumentation Standard), relevant architects, language Dev, and the Release Engineer (rollout/flag). The author does not clear its own hard veto. **End with the status table:** Completed | Remaining | Best next action.


**Last action — discoverability (V10, `knowledge/knowledge-visualization.md`):** write the artifact's **frontmatter** (id, type, status, owner, typed links per the relation registry, review-by per the type's SLA, real summary — V2/V13/V14) and sync the derived index via the **script bundle** `python3 docs/ai-forward-pack/scripts/docs-graph.py derive` (`flag` for V16) — no ad-hoc scripts (V18); ensure `docs/index.html` (the Docs Explorer) exists; verify the artifact is linked into the graph; on **material change**, flag inbound neighbors `review-suggested` (V16); capture sub-ADR decisions/assumptions as linked **decision notes** in `docs/notes/` (V17) — same change as the content; frontmatter wins where the index disagrees.


**Running this in Copilot (single agent — make the dialog visible).** Copilot does not auto-spawn the personas as separate subagents the way Claude Code does, so enact the round-table *inline*: first **ground** in the prior `docs/` artifacts (spec → architecture → design) and treat them as authoritative; then for each peer named above, write a short labeled contribution in that persona's voice (e.g. **Patterns Expert —** …); then run the adversary round, each reviewer giving a labeled critique with a severity **[Blocker|Major|Minor|Nit]** and, for hard-veto roles, an explicit **PASS/BLOCK** plus the veto-clears-when predicate (`persona-cards.md` §8). Do not collapse this into one unattributed answer — the dialog is the deliverable. (Alternatively `@`-mention a specific agent from `.github/agents/` for a focused single-persona pass, or use agent **handoffs** to chain the stages.)

**Audit (last action):** append an audit-log entry for this run via `python3 docs/ai-forward-pack/scripts/audit-log.py append --shortname "implement-<subject>" --session "<id>" --skill implement --kind skill --prompt "<verbatim>" --summary "<what shipped + Proof Pack>" --artifact <changed paths>` (the Audit Mandate, `knowledge/audit-and-change-log.md`, AL5); if a decision was made mid-build, add a change entry too (`audit-log.py change`, CL1). Emit the honest watcher signals (AL2a): add `--signal-acceptance-met true` + `--signal-verification-path true` (and `--signal-verification-executed true` when controls were seen red-first) **only when genuinely true** — a run that missed its `done_when` or shipped no Proof Pack omits the flag, so the watcher scores conservatively rather than on a fabricated value (L127/NG1); never pass the judgement-laden `guidance_*`/`coordination_*` counts by hand.
